title: Version 3.11: Side Chats and Conversation Search
description: Cursor 3.11 introduces side chats that run alongside your main chat for parallel AI conversations, conversation search for agent transcripts with Cmd+K and Cmd+F, redesigned project and repo pickers, new cloud agent hooks for observing and controlling agent conversations, MCPs and Organizations in Team Marketplaces, Cursor Mobile App for iOS with cloud agents and remote control, unified Customize page, and enhanced Cursor Automations with /automate skill and new GitHub/Slack triggers.

community_feedback.quote: I like working in jetbrains more than in a cursor but the power that cursor gives is something you can't miss in 2026
Cursor is no longer primarily about writing code

title: In-app browser on Desktop
description: Claude Code on desktop gets a built-in browser, so Claude can pull up docs, designs, or any other site and interact with pages the same way it does with local dev server previews. Also includes /doctor command for full setup diagnostics that can fix issues, auto mode blocks transcript tampering and asks before rm -rf on unresolved variables, and agent view rows show colored state word and classifier-written headline.

community_feedback.quote: I've been using Claude Code and honestly, I'm amazed every time

title: Auto model selection for enterprises
description: Enterprises can now default to auto model selection, allowing Copilot to intelligently route tasks to the most appropriate AI model based on system health and model performance. Additionally, enterprise managed-settings.json is generally available, new C++ language server config skill added for Copilot CLI, and Kimi K2.7 Code is now generally available.

title: Copilot Vision generally available
description: GitHub Copilot Vision is now generally available, allowing developers to get AI assistance directly from visual interfaces. Browser tools for GitHub Copilot in VS Code are also generally available, enabling AI to browse and interact with web content. AI credit session limits can now be set in Copilot CLI and SDK for better cost management.

title: Claude Sonnet 5 generally available
description: Claude Sonnet 5 is now generally available for GitHub Copilot, bringing advanced AI coding capabilities to all users. Copilot Agent is now available in JetBrains AI Assistant for enhanced IDE integration. Per-user AI credit budgets are now available for cost centers, enabling better resource allocation and tracking.

title: Copilot CLI auto model selection
description: Copilot CLI auto model selection now routes based on task type, ensuring optimal model selection for different types of development work. This improvement helps tailor AI assistance to specific coding tasks by automatically choosing the most appropriate model for the job.

title: Claude Opus 4.8 (fast mode) preview
description: Claude Opus 4.8 (fast mode) is now in preview for GitHub Copilot, offering faster response times for coding tasks while maintaining high-quality outputs. Additionally, MAI-Code-1-Flash is now available for Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise plans.

title: Claude Sonnet 5: New default model
description: Claude Sonnet 5 became the new default model for Pro, Team Standard, and Enterprise subscription seats, featuring top-tier coding and tool use at Sonnet pricing, native 1M-token context window, and adaptive thinking on by default. Also includes Claude in Chrome generally available, subagents run in background by default, Claude Desktop on Linux in beta, and /radio command.
